suite: 3D pane follows the selection (sweep, bind, reload, hover)
expect_red: [real] in bind mode a bound feature's body is the same line and the same actions

mutations.contract: The page draws a feature's body from the model's plan, in either pane mode.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_binding_shows_the_moment_it_is_made_and_is_corrected_where_it_is_shown (2026-11-12), which replaced the 11-10 guards that pinned the pane's rows under a bound feature. Drops the plan, so the body falls back to whatever rows the pane lists.
mutations.find: var plan = feature ? VA.featureBodyPlan(model, fid, state.topologyId, rows, sceneTree) : null;
